title: Leadership Competency Survey
description: The Leadership Assessment is a 360-degree feedback process through which information is gathered about a participant's behavior at work from colleagues, direct reports, and manager. This survey will ask you specific questions about the person listed above.

pages.name: page1
pages.title: How familiar are you with this person?
pages.description: To start, we need to get a sense of how well you know the person you are being asked to rate.

elements.name: question1
elements.title: How well would you say that you know the performance of the individual you are rating?

elements.name: question2
elements.title: Compared to other people doing the same work, how effective would you say this person is?

pages.name: page2
pages.title: Characteristics of this leader
pages.description: If you feel you cannot rate the person on a particular behavior, please select "Don't know"

elements.name: question3
elements.title: How characteristic is this behavior of this individual?

rows.text: Translates the organization vision into realistic business strategies and links to larger organizational efforts.
Paints a compelling picture to others of what the future could be, promoting the vision through word and action.

elements.name: question4
elements.title: How characteristic is this behavior of this individual?

rows.text: Understands how work and decisions made locally can have farther reaching impact.
Understands global markets and uses that knowledge to effectively build and execute business plans.
Recognizes differences, and adjusts style to align with different cultures.

elements.name: question5
elements.title: How characteristic is this behavior of this individual?

rows.text: Is thoroughly conversant regarding major aspects of own business unit operations, technical developments, systems, etc.
Demonstrates broad knowledge of the business, markets, competitor position, products and technologies.
Anticipates future trends and how these changes in the global marketplace may affect Momentive.

pages.name: page3
pages.title: Characteristics of this leader
pages.description: If you feel you cannot rate the person on a particular behavior, please select "Don't know"

elements.name: question6
elements.title: How characteristic is this behavior of this individual?

rows.text: Respects diversity of talent and understands its value.
Has accurate and actionable succession and development plans for each member of the team.
Takes the initiative to provide coaching and feedback to others.

elements.name: question7
elements.title: How characteristic is this behavior of this individual?

rows.text: Gains commitment from others before implemnting changes.
Acts with honesty and transparency.
Demonstrates respect for alternative opinions; values openness and candor.

elements.name: question8
elements.title: How characteristic is this behavior of this individual?

rows.text: Appropriately pushes decision making down, allowing others to develop their decision making and accountability.
Does not micro-manage others' work.
Creates a climate that encourages autonomy.

elements.name: question9
elements.title: How characteristic is this behavior of this individual?

rows.text: Effectively manages conflict for the best outcome.
Effectively listens, clarifies, and finds common ground.
Deals with conflicts directly and in a timely manner.

elements.name: question10
elements.title: How characteristic is this behavior of this individual?

rows.text: Ensures understanding of messages received and provided.
Keeps others informed about safety-related information (e.g., big picture as well as detail).
Actively listens and creates an atmosphere for constructive communication.

elements.name: question11
elements.title: How characteristic is this behavior of this individual?

rows.text: Appeals to other's most important values and beliefs.
Builds "behind-the-scenes" support for ideas (e.g., socializes ideas to gain support before a meeting).
Uses ethical considerations to guide decisions and actions.

pages.title: Characteristics of this leader

elements.name: question12
elements.title: How characteristic is this behavior of this individual?

rows.text: Motivates others to achieve extraordinary levels of accomplishment both in terms of performance as well as their own development.
Sets high standards and communicates about objectives enthusiastically.
Articulates a compelling vision and communicates confidence about achieving it.

elements.name: question13
elements.title: How characteristic is this behavior of this individual?

rows.text: Constructively questions the status quo by questioning assumptions that have been used previously.
Encourages others to approach problems from many angles perhaps not previously considered.
Offers help and information to enlarge the perspective used by others to understand problems.

elements.name: question14
elements.title: How characteristic is this behavior of this individual?

rows.text: Simplifies complex problems/strategies into actionable items.
Demonstrates a sense of urgency by focusing on the most important priorities.
Achieves results in a manner consistent with company's strategy and Core Values.

elements.name: question15
elements.title: How characteristic is this behavior of this individual?

rows.text: Follows an organized, step-based approach to manage change in the organization.
Positively engages, motivates and influences others around change initiatives.
Does not get discouraged easily in the face of change and/or industry volatility.

elements.name: question16
elements.title: How characteristic is this behavior of this individual?

rows.text: Actively seeks feedback and is open to learning from mistakes.
Reflects on feedback from others and adjusts behavior accordingly.
Adjusts quickly and efficiently to organizational changes/shifts in strategy
